gloss: to gaze at; to stare intently

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見入|みい}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to gaze at; to stare intently; to be transfixed by
definitions.explanation: To look at something so intently that one becomes absorbed in it. Implies fascination or deep interest rather than a blank stare. Compound of 見 (to look) + 入る (to enter), suggesting one's gaze enters deeply into the object.

examples.english: I gazed intently at the painting.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見入|みい}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children are staring intently at the fish in the tank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{見入|みい}ってしまった。
examples.english: I found myself involuntarily gazing at the beauty of the sunset.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb (る ending, conjugates as r-row: {見入|みい}らない, {見入|みい}ります). Takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the object being gazed at: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見入|みい}る.

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず (involuntarily) to convey that the viewer was so captivated they couldn't help but stare. The nuance is always positive absorption, not hostile staring.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見入|みい}る (to gaze at ~)
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{見入|みい}る (to involuntarily become absorbed in looking)
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧{見入|みい}る (to stare fixedly)
